title: Beast
html:
Beasts are a type of creature found within Baldur's Gate 3. They are non-humanoid, but natural inhabitants of the world and come in many different shapes and sizes.

“
All varieties of animals, both ordinary and magical. Most have limited intelligence and lack a society and language.
„
— In-game racial description

Characteristics

Most beasts, though not all of them, resemble common animals. Typically, beasts make frequent use of natural weapons like claws, teeth, and horns to inflict ⁠Slashing, ⁠Piercing or ⁠Bludgeoning damage. Some beasts, like spiders, have additional special (but still natural) abilities like creating webs.

Types of beasts

Alioramus

Main articles: Alioramus and  Alioramus on the Forgotten Realms Wiki
“
Alioramus are sedulous hunters, their broad jaws capable of crushing a knight's chest through a full inch of iron plate.
„
— In-game racial description

Alioramus are a type of dinosaur beast found in the jungles of  Chult. They resemble real-life renditions of velociraptors, down to their ability to use claws to attack and legs to pounce on their enemies.

Alioramus in Baldur's Gate 3

  •  Chult Alioramus
  •  Chult Alioramus Colossa

Badger

Main articles: Badger and  Badger on the Forgotten Realms Wiki
“
Striped ponderous wanderers of the woods.
„
— In-game racial description

Badgers are burrowing beasts characterized by white stripes, giant claws, and sensitive nose.

Badgers in Baldur's Gate 3

  •  Postmaster Badger

Bat

Main articles: Bat and  Bat on the Forgotten Realms Wiki
“
Reliant upon echolocation, bats fill the caves of the world with shrieks like the ghoulish little winged mice they are.
„
— In-game racial description

Bats are small mammalian beasts that fly mainly at night, and navigate and hunt insects via echolocation.

Bird

Main articles: Bird and  Bird on the Forgotten Realms Wiki
“
Their melodies fill the woods of Toril with a mellow sweetness, and their feathers paint brush strokes on even the dullest sky.
„
— In-game racial description

Birds are winged creatures with feathers and a lightweight body that allow them to fly. They have a hard beak which lets them forage or attack prey.

Birds in Baldur's Gate 3

  •  Blue Jay
  •  Commander Lightfeather
  •  Dishevelled Chicken

Boar

Main articles: Boar and  Boar on the Forgotten Realms Wiki
“
Bulky and tusked, wild boar are at their most dangerous during mating season, and can use those tusks and the muscle in their bodies to gore and crush.
„
— In-game racial description

Boar are the wild cousins of the domesticated pig. They frequently use their tusks to ward off larger creatures or defend territory.

Boar in Baldur's Gate 3

  •  Scared Boar
  •  Tusk
  •  Verres
  •  Verres Calamitosus
  •  Verres Major

Crab

Main articles: Crab and  Crab on the Forgotten Realms Wiki
“
The member of nature's ecological club most likely to pinch your ankles.
„
— In-game racial description

Crabs are multi-legged crustaceans that live in the sea and sport an armoured shell covering their entire body. They have two large claws which they use to defend themselves.

Crabs in Baldur's Gate 3

  •  Armoured Crab
  •  Conjured Crab

Displacer Beast

Main articles: Displacer Beast and  Displacer beast on the Forgotten Realms Wiki
“
A displacer beast's coat is slick with illusory magic that can bend light, letting it project images of itself and turn invisible. Adventurers say you can never know a displacer beast's true location - until its claws sink into your belly, that is.
„
— In-game racial description

Displacer beast are cat-like, six-legged magical creatures with a pair of tentacles instead of a tail. They can use magic to bend light and create illusions.

Displacer beasts in Baldur's Gate 3

  •  Nessa
  •  Shadow-Whiskers

Frog

Main articles: Frog and  Frog on the Forgotten Realms Wiki
“
These hopping fellows look terribly unfortunate, which isn't a problem, because they sound absolutely miserable, too.
„
— In-game racial description

Frogs are carnivorous, amphibious creatures that dwell in a variety of climates eating insects. They are characterized by strong hind legs which allow them to leap distances many times its own body length.

Frogs in Baldur's Gate 3

  •  Addled Frog
  •  Conjured Frog

Giant Eagle

Main articles: Giant Eagle and  Giant Eagle on the Forgotten Realms Wiki
“
Though noble and giant in stature, these eagles are barely smarter than their smaller counterparts
„
— In-game racial description

Giant Eagle are large carnivorous birds with much larger wingspans. Unlike regular eagles, Giant Eagles are often as large or larger than humanoids. Though typically not aggressive, they are fiercely defensive of their nests.

Giant eagles in Baldur's Gate 3

  •  Ancient Giant Eagle

Hyena

Main articles: Hyena and  Hyena on the Forgotten Realms Wiki
“
Of all subspecies of hyena, only the spotted ones emit that strange cackling giggle that raises the hairs on the neck of a savanna hunter.
„
— In-game racial description

Hyenas are canine-like creatures, but are significantly more feral than dogs. They mostly live in packs to hunt and protect their food.

Hyena in Baldur's Gate 3

  •  Bloated Hyena
  •  Hyena (Shadow-Cursed Lands)

Rat

Main articles: Rat and  Rat on the Forgotten Realms Wiki
“
Sure, they carry disease, but there's something inherently gossip-laden about the expression of a rat, as if they know all your secrets.
„
— In-game racial description

Rats are small rodent creatures that typically reside in sewers, or places with lots of garbage that can be scavenged for food. Because of this, they can be found in humanoid settlements where there is a ready supply of refuse.

Rats in Baldur's Gate 3

  •  Cranium Rat
  •  Giant Rat
  •  Necrotic Rat
  •  Soporific Rat

Raven

Main articles: Raven and  Raven on the Forgotten Realms Wiki
“
Ravens are often employed as messengers or decorative scene-setting by a certain kind of wizard (the kind that drinks out of skull goblets and owns dribbly candles).
„
— In-game racial description

Ravens are relatively larger and more intelligent versions of birds; they have black wings and make a distinctive "caw".

Ravens in Baldur's Gate 3

  •  Corvus
  •  Corvus Celer
  •  Corvus Major
  •  Quothe
  •  Raven (white)
  •  Shadow-Cursed Raven

Spider

Main articles: Spider and  Spider on the Forgotten Realms Wiki
“
Eight-legged, spindly, and generally awful.
„
— In-game racial description

Spiders are eight-legged invertebrates that are characterized by their many legs and ability to spin webs, which they use to catch their prey.

Spiders in Baldur's Gate 3

  •  Aggressive Crag Spider
  •  Aranea
  •  Aranea Major
  •  Aranea Aculeata
  •  Combustion Belly Spiderling
  •  Crag Spider
  •  Larger Giant Spider
  •  Smaller Giant Spider
  •  Sword Spider

Wolf

Main articles: Wolf and  Wolf on the Forgotten Realms Wiki
“
Furtive pack animals roaming the wilderness, wolves are wary of attacking creatures unless driven to ferocity by territorialism or hunger.
„
— In-game racial description

Wolves are wilder, larger versions of dogs. Although some of them can be loners, they usually hunt in packs to take down large prey.

Wolves in Baldur's Gate 3

  •  Lupus
  •  Lupus Major
  •  Lupus Optumus
  •  Dire Wolf
  •  Dire Wolf (wild shape)

  •  Cat

  •  Rabbit
  •  Squirrel

Related items

  • Arrow of Beast Slaying - consumable arrow which deals double damage against beast targets.
  • Hoots' Hooch -  Hoots' Hooch: Beast Tongue grants  Disadvantage on Charisma checks and Animal Handling checks against Beasts.
  • Nature's Snare -  Ensnares targets only if they are not a plant or a beast.
  • Rat Bat -  Advantage on attack rolls against beasts
  • The Oak Father's Embrace - beasts that strike the wearer deal extra ⁠Radiant damage.

Related spells and abilities

  •  Animal Friendship - applies  Charmed to beasts
  •  Animating Spores - can only be used on Monstrosities, Humanoids, or Beasts
  •  Burden of Time Aura - beasts have  Disadvantage on saving throws within 3 m (10 ft) of the creature with the aura
  •  Charm Animals and Plants - applies  Charmed to all nearby beasts and plants
  •  Dominate Beast - allows the caster to control a beast for up to 10 turns
  •  Fear Aura - Fear only applies to beasts and humanoids
  •  Fungal Infestation - can only be used on beasts and humanoids
  •  Speak with Animals,  Beast Speech,  Potion of Animal Speaking - allows speaking to most beasts
